column1: # TeX Live's manuals (ci/manuals.json) whose PDF is identical to the oracle at -j1 and -j4 given time, but which run past the gate's time limit (the sweep's 300 s, or the manual's own time_limit_s: pdflatex's wall on the gate's runner): slower than pdflatex. A speed item, not a correctness one (the user, 2026-11-04: an exact PDF is correct however long it takes). The gate keeps its limit for them, so a timeout of one here is expected and reported apart (known-red.txt, "slow (listed)"), never red; a PDF that differs or an error from one stays red. Each row: the id, a tab, the measured times (PhiTeX at -j1 and -j4, pdflatex, the node and job) and the date.
